# NimoteCode

> NimoteCode is a mobile IDE and SSH workspace for Android, iPhone and iPad. Use the editor, terminal and Git to work on local files or a project on your own development host. AI is optional.

## Product

- [Features](https://nimotecode.com/features): IDE, Terminal, AI and Host modes and their prerequisites.
- [Free and Pro](https://nimotecode.com/pro): Plan comparison, trial terms and in-app pricing.
- [Download](https://nimotecode.com/download): Official Google Play and App Store listings.
- [Release notes](https://nimotecode.com/releases/): Current and upcoming releases.
- [Product reference](https://nimotecode.com/llms-full.txt): Platform, entitlement and companion-product details.

## Documentation

- [Quick Start](https://nimotecode.com/docs/quick-start): Set up a local or SSH workspace.
- [SSH Workspace](https://nimotecode.com/docs/ssh): Connect to a development machine you can access.
- [AI Chat and Agent](https://nimotecode.com/docs/ai): Bring your own model provider and API key.
- [NimoteHost Community](https://nimotecode.com/docs/host): Open-source service for persistent host-side workflows.
- [Nimote Connect](https://nimotecode.com/docs/connect): Desktop companion, preview status and network prerequisites.
- [Account and subscription](https://nimotecode.com/docs/account-subscription): Verify eligibility and restore purchases.
- [FAQ](https://nimotecode.com/docs/faq): Platforms, workspace setup and plan questions.

## Workflows

- [Android IDE](https://nimotecode.com/android-ide): Local files, SSH, and Local Linux on supported devices.
- [SSH client for iPhone and iPad](https://nimotecode.com/iphone-ssh-client): Terminal and remote file access.
- [Remote development on iPad](https://nimotecode.com/ipad-coding): Set up a workflow with your own host.
- [Claude Code from a phone](https://nimotecode.com/claude-code-from-phone): Use Claude Code installed and authenticated on the SSH host.
- [Codex from a phone](https://nimotecode.com/codex-from-phone): Use the Codex CLI installed and authenticated on the SSH host.
- [Git and GitHub](https://nimotecode.com/docs/source-control): Inspect diffs and check which write workflows require Pro.
